title: BVALID Held High After BREADY Handshake
description: After a successful B-channel handshake (BVALID=1 && BREADY=1), BVALID is not cleared, causing the master to misinterpret the next cycle as a second write response.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [AXI_PROT_CHECK] Duplicate BVALID detected — no new write in progress
expected_root_cause: The BVALID clear logic is missing its enable condition; it only sets BVALID but never clears it after the handshake [1, 9].
failure_log:
T=100: BVALID=1, BREADY=1 (handshake OK)
T=110: BVALID=1 (stuck)
UVM_ERROR: Spurious BVALID.
success_log: BVALID cleared on posedge clk following BREADY handshake.
fix_replacement: always_ff @(posedge clk) begin if (!rst_n) bvalid <= 0; else if (wr_done) bvalid <= 1; else if (bvalid && bready) bvalid <= 0; end
testbench: task run(); drive_write(); @(posedge clk iff bvalid && bready); @(posedge clk); assert(bvalid == 0); endtask
